sprints.title: Sprint 0: Inception, UI/UX Prototyping & DevOps Foundation
sprints.goal: Repository initialized, UI mockups generated via Google Stitch, local Docker environment running, and CI pipeline green on a starter Django app.

items.title: Generate UI/UX wireframes & high-fidelity mockups using design.md prompts in Google Stitch
acceptance: Exported screens for Feed, Event Detail, QR Pass, and Organizer Dashboard are committed or linked in `docs/`.

items.title: Initialize Django project with modular `apps/` structure and split settings (`base`, `local`, `staging`, `prod`)
acceptance: Uses `django-environ` for 12-Factor App environment variables.
`.env.example` is provided; no secrets are committed to Git.

items.title: Create multi-container `docker-compose.yml` (`web`, `postgres`, `redis`, `celery`, `mailpit`)
acceptance: Any student can run `docker compose up --build` and get the full local stack running in one command.
The local email testing server (`mailpit`) is part of the stack.

items.title: Configure GitHub Actions CI workflow (`ci-backend.yml`) for Linting, Formatting & Unit Tests
acceptance: Every PR triggers a `ruff`/`black` check.
`pytest` runs against a PostgreSQL service container.
Merge is blocked when the workflow fails.

sprints.title: Sprint 1: Universities, Campuses & Academic Identity
sprints.goal: Rwandan universities and campuses modeled; students can register, verify their institution, and log in via Web and JWT API.

items.title: As a platform admin, I want to manage Universities, Campuses (e.g., UR-CST, CMU-Africa, ALU, AUCA), and Venues with GPS coordinates
acceptance: Django models and migrations exist for University, Campus and Venue.
Management command `seed_rwandan_campuses` pre-populates Kigali universities.

items.title: As a student/faculty member, I want to register with my institutional email and automatically receive my Verified University Badge
acceptance: The registration email domain is matched against `University.email_domains`.
A verification email is sent via Celery + Mailpit (dev) / SMTP (prod).
UI: registration and verification screens (Frontend track).

items.title: Expose `/api/v1/auth/` (JWT login, refresh, profile) and `/api/v1/institutions/campuses/` with OpenAPI/Swagger docs
acceptance: OpenAPI docs configured via `drf-spectacular` at `/api/schema/swagger-ui/`.
90%+ test coverage on auth endpoints.

items.title: Add SAST (Static Application Security Testing) & Secret Scanning to GitHub Actions
acceptance: `bandit` (Python security linter) runs in CI.
`pip-audit` (dependency vulnerability check) runs in CI.
`trufflehog` or `gitleaks` secret scanning runs in CI.

sprints.title: Sprint 2: Event Publication, Access Policies & Discovery Feed
sprints.goal: Organizers can publish academic events with cross-campus access rules; students can search and filter events across Kigali.

items.title: As an organizer, I want to create an academic event and set its Access Policy (`PUBLIC_COMMUNITY`, `OPEN_ALL_UNIVERSITIES`, `INSTITUTION_ONLY`, `CAMPUS_ONLY`) and Delivery Mode (`IN_PERSON`, `ONLINE`, `HYBRID`)
acceptance: Implemented using the Service Layer (`services.py`).
Django Forms and DRF Serializers share the same validation logic.

items.title: As a student, I want to browse the responsive Discovery Feed and filter by Host University, Academic Tag, Date, and "Open to Me"
acceptance: Implements the design tokens in `design_docs/design_v3.md` §2 as CSS custom properties.
Uses `<UniversityBadge />` and `<AccessPolicyPill />` components.
HTMX provides instant filtering.

items.title: As a user, I want to view events on an interactive Kigali Campus Map
acceptance: Uses Leaflet.js + OpenStreetMap.
Consumes `/api/v1/events/?format=geojson` to plot active events by campus coordinates (API track).

items.title: Build multi-stage production `Dockerfile` and publish tagged images to GitHub Container Registry (`ghcr.io`)
acceptance: Container runs as a non-root user on a slim Python base image.
Static files are collected and served via WhiteNoise/Nginx.
Image is pushed to `ghcr.io` on merge to `main`.

sprints.title: Sprint 3: RSVP Engine, Inter-University QR Gate Pass & Calendar Sync
sprints.goal: Students from one university can RSVP to an open event at another university and receive a verifiable QR Gate Pass for campus security.

items.title: As a student, I want to RSVP to an open event at another university and get waitlisted automatically if external seat quotas are full
acceptance: Uses database row locking (`select_for_update()`) to prevent race conditions during popular hackathon registrations.
Users are waitlisted automatically when the external seat quota is full.

items.title: As an attendee, I want a downloadable/mobile-friendly Inter-University Visitor QR Gate Pass and `.ics` Calendar file
acceptance: Generates a cryptographically signed (`HMAC-SHA256`) QR code.
The pass displays Student Name, Home University, Target Campus Gate instructions, and Pass ID.
A downloadable `.ics` calendar file is provided (Frontend track: mobile-friendly pass view).

items.title: As a campus organizer/moderator, I want to scan QR passes at the door and export a Campus Security Visitor Roster (CSV/PDF)
acceptance: Provides the `/api/v1/tickets/verify-qr/` endpoint.
Provides a downloadable security manifest (CSV/PDF) for university gate guards.

items.title: Provision Staging Environment & Automated CD Pipeline (`cd-staging.yml`)
acceptance: Containerized stack (Django, Gunicorn, Nginx, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery) deploys to a cloud VM (DigitalOcean/AWS/Render/Railway).
Staging is served over Let's Encrypt HTTPS.
Merges to `main` deploy to Staging automatically.

sprints.title: Sprint 4: Smart Notifications, Real-Time Alerts & Background Workers
sprints.goal: Automated cross-university notifications when matching academic events are published or when urgent venue changes happen.

items.title: As a student, I want to subscribe to specific academic tags (`#DevOps`, `#AI`) and campuses so I get alerted when relevant events are posted
acceptance: A Celery task fans out notifications asynchronously to matching subscribers when an event transitions to `PUBLISHED`.

items.title: As an attendee, I want instant alerts if an event room changes or starts soon (24h and 2h reminders)
acceptance: Celery Beat scheduled periodic tasks send the 24h and 2h reminders.
In-app notification bell dropdown with an unread counter (Frontend track).

items.title: Implement Application Health Checks, Centralized Logging & Prometheus/Grafana Monitoring
acceptance: `/healthz` and `/metrics` endpoints are exposed.
Prometheus + Grafana (or Loki) are deployed via Docker Compose.
Dashboards monitor API latency, Celery queue depth, and HTTP 5xx errors.

sprints.title: Sprint 5: Hardening, Load Testing & Phase 1/2 Release
sprints.goal: Stress-test the Django Web + REST API platform, fix bottlenecks with Redis caching, and finalize OpenAPI documentation for mobile/SPA teams.

items.title: Cache high-traffic event discovery endpoints and campus directories using Redis
acceptance: Cache invalidation is triggered automatically on event creation/update.
DB queries on the home feed are reduced by more than 70%.

items.title: Conduct Load Testing with `Locust` or `k6` simulating 500 concurrent Kigali students RSVPing to a hackathon
acceptance: Students analyze Grafana dashboards during the load test and identify bottlenecks.
Gunicorn workers and DB connection pooling are tuned based on the findings.

items.title: Database Backup Automation & Disaster Recovery Drill
acceptance: Automated daily `pg_dump` cron/container uploads to S3-compatible object storage.
The restore procedure is documented and has been tested.

sprints.title: Sprint 6 (Phase 3 Expansion): Flutter Mobile App & Push Notifications
sprints.goal: Build the cross-platform Flutter companion app consuming `/api/v1/`.

items.title: Initialize Flutter app with `AppTheme` matching `design.md` tokens, JWT storage (`flutter_secure_storage`), and Event Feed screen
acceptance: Consumes `/api/v1/events/` and `/api/v1/auth/token/`.
Supports pull-to-refresh and university filter chips.

items.title: Implement Offline-First Digital Gate Pass Wallet & Organizer QR Scanner in Flutter
acceptance: Caches the student's QR Gate Passes locally (`hive`/`sqflite`) so they work without mobile data at campus gates.
Uses `mobile_scanner` for organizer check-in.

items.title: Integrate Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for real-time mobile push notifications
acceptance: A Django Celery worker pushes FCM alerts when a subscribed campus posts a new open event (Backend track).

items.title: Create GitHub Actions Mobile CI Pipeline (`ci-mobile-flutter.yml`)
acceptance: Runs `flutter analyze` and `flutter test`.
Builds a signed release APK artifact attached to GitHub Releases.

sprints.title: Sprint 7 (Phase 4 Expansion): Component-Based SPA in React or Angular
sprints.goal: Build a decoupled modern SPA consuming the exact same `/api/v1/` backend.

items.title: Scaffold React (Vite/Next.js) or Angular project with shared CSS variables from `design.md` and typed API client (auto-generated from OpenAPI spec)
acceptance: Uses `openapi-typescript-codegen` or `@openapitools/openapi-generator-cli` against Django's `/api/schema/`.
Frontend types never drift from backend models.

items.title: Build Component Library (`<EventCard />`, `<UniversityBadge />`, `<AccessPolicyPill />`, `<FilterSidebar />`, `<KigaliCampusMap />`)
acceptance: Full interactive discovery experience.
JWT interceptor handles auth for API calls.
Organizer Analytics dashboard.

items.title: Configure SPA CI/CD Pipeline (`ci-frontend-spa.yml`) & Reverse Proxy Routing
acceptance: Runs ESLint and Vitest/Karma unit tests.
Builds the static bundle into an Nginx container (or CDN).
CORS and reverse proxy rules are configured alongside `/api/v1/`.
